summary: AtlasClear Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing an October 14, 2026 business combination agreement to acquire Ark Financial Services, owner of broker-dealer Dawson James Securities. AtlasClear paid $2.5M cash plus a $2.5M 5% seller note for an initial 24.9% stake, with the remaining equity to be acquired at a subsequent closing for $2,437,500 cash plus $13,812,500 in stock priced at a five-day VWAP, plus up to $812,500 cash and $2,437,500 in stock deferred consideration tied to revenue. The Keyser Trust is the counterparty; Keyser is an AtlasClear director, signaling a related-party transaction warranting governance scrutiny.
